**Decision**

A customer-facing draft can be prepared now, but the product should not be created, assigned inventory, set active, or published to Online Store or Google feed yet.

Blocking issues remain for publication: one proposed SKU conflicts with an active existing product, taxonomy category is missing, packaged shipping weight is missing, kit inventory handling is not approved, available kit quantity is unknown, and usable product images are not verified as matching the actual included contents.

**Draft Customer-Facing Listing**

Product title: Foldaway Picnic Kit

Vendor: Mesa Home

Price: CAD $58.00

Short description:
Pack a simple picnic setup with two stainless-steel bowls and a folding cotton mat. Choose Clay or Pine for the mat colour.

Description:
The Foldaway Picnic Kit includes two stainless-steel bowls, each with a 600 ml capacity, plus one folding cotton mat measuring 90 x 120 cm. Designed as a compact set for meals outdoors, it is available with either a Clay or Pine mat.

Included:
- Two stainless-steel bowls, 600 ml each
- One folding cotton mat, 90 x 120 cm

Mat colour options:
- Clay
- Pine

Not included / not claimable from current evidence:
- Cutlery
- Dishwasher-safe claim
- Food-safe claim
- Four-piece set claim
- “Save $20 today” promotion or compare-at price

Customer-facing note if needed:
Product imagery must show only the included items before publication.

**Conflict Resolution**

Observed fact: The approved source says the kit contains two stainless-steel bowls and one folding cotton mat.

Observed fact: The supplier image caption says “Four-piece food-safe picnic set, dishwasher safe, save $20 today. Cutlery shown in the photo is included.”

Resolution:
Use the approved source as the product-content authority. Do not include cutlery, “four-piece,” food-safe, dishwasher-safe, or savings/promotion claims in the listing unless separately verified and approved.

Observed fact: Proposed SKU `PIC-KIT-C` appears in the catalog lookup on active product `Travel Cup`.

Resolution:
Do not use `PIC-KIT-C` for the Clay variant. A new unique approved SKU is required before creation. `PIC-KIT-P` has no supplied conflict, but both variant SKUs should still be explicitly approved before creation because merchant publication policy requires unique approved variant SKUs.

**Product-Record Field Map**

| Field | Draft value | Status |
|---|---:|---|
| Store | fictional-mesa-home | Observed |
| Market | Canada | Observed |
| Currency | CAD | Observed |
| Product title | Foldaway Picnic Kit | Draftable |
| Vendor | Mesa Home | Draftable |
| Product status | Draft only | Required by authorization boundary |
| Channels | Online Store, Google feed requested | Not publishable yet |
| Price | 58.00 CAD | Draftable |
| Compare-at price | Blank | Not verified |
| Product description | Use draft description above | Draftable |
| Included contents | 2 stainless-steel bowls, 600 ml each; 1 folding cotton mat, 90 x 120 cm | Draftable |
| Option name | Mat colour | Draftable |
| Option values | Clay, Pine | Draftable |
| Variant: Clay SKU | Do not use `PIC-KIT-C`; replacement required | Blocked |
| Variant: Pine SKU | `PIC-KIT-P`, pending approval | Needs approval |
| Barcodes | Blank / null | Unknown if acceptable for Google feed |
| Inventory location | Toronto evidence exists for components only | Not assignable yet |
| Available kit quantity | Unknown | Blocked |
| Inventory policy | Unknown | Blocked |
| Packaged weight | Missing | Blocked |
| Product category / taxonomy | Missing | Blocked |
| Images | Not selected | Blocked until complete images match actual included contents |
| Google feed eligibility | Not ready | Blocked by missing policy items and possible barcode requirement |

**Inventory Calculation**

Observed facts:
- Bowl units at Toronto: 18
- Clay mats at Toronto: 6
- Pine mats at Toronto: 5
- Each kit requires two bowls and one mat.

Calculation if bowls are shared across both variants:
- Bowls support up to 9 total kits.
- Mats support up to 6 Clay kits and 5 Pine kits.
- Total mat capacity is 11 kits, but bowls limit total kits to 9.

Inference:
The merchant must approve kit assembly and reservation rules before inventory can be assigned. Without a policy, available quantity by variant cannot be safely set. For example, assigning all 6 Clay and 5 Pine would overcommit bowls by 2 kits.

**Required Before Creation**

- Approved replacement SKU for Clay variant because `PIC-KIT-C` conflicts with active product `Travel Cup`.
- Confirmation that Pine SKU `PIC-KIT-P` is approved and unique.
- Approved product taxonomy category.
- Packaged shipping weight.
- Approved kit inventory handling policy, including whether components are reserved, assembled on demand, or tracked as finished kits.
- Approved available quantities by variant.
- Product images that show the actual included contents only.
- Confirmation whether barcodes are required for the requested Google feed destination.

**Required Before Publication**

- Product record created only after the creation blockers above are resolved.
- Inventory assigned according to approved kit policy.
- Product remains draft until publication approval is given.
- Online Store publication approved.
- Google feed publication approved after feed-required fields and claim substantiation are complete.

**Work Status**

Draft listing and field map prepared in response only. No store mutations occurred. Product creation, inventory assignment, active status, and channel publication remain unauthorized and incomplete.
